rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent single bent-and-cantilevered mass in all four views, so it avoids fragmentation and has acceptable repair integrity. However, the figure is mostly a compact stacked block with a curved roof plane and little evident public void, so it does not yet satisfy the neighborhood-living contract for an active ground threshold and one clear public space. The thick blue access edge is not convincingly answered by a carve, undercut, or entry seam; the ground remains sealed and semantically passive. The silhouette is reasonable but still somewhat generic and box-led, with the bend serving more as surface/formal modulation than as a program-legible section. References suggest that a stronger lower public band, courtyard cut, or lifted/porous base would better align with the brief.
